name: Prepare the script and scenes
criteria: Preserve the user-requested production method, including a source-reference workflow when adoption was requested
Script and scenes identify character, reference, voice, and video stages required by the intended media in the saved method plan without inventing unavailable capabilities
Method plan recorded as a run input or planning output with its path and SHA-256
Assumptions, costs, and applicable authorization identified; unavailable required stages remain pending
No silent method substitution or stage omission; preserve approved identity and references
